transcription.text: I ran it back again tonight, same input, same design Something flickers underneath a quiet misalignment A question I can't silence, has this ever worked? I traced the steps I thought were clean Follow patterns I've already seen Every path I marked is true Pins until it isn't you Versions whisper and collapse small inconsistencies and maps I frame the test I set the scope Now I don't believe the hope I keep asking in the breath like it's something more than this Am I testing the right branch or just proving what I am? Has this ever worked? Or did I just believe it did? Did I miss the point? I've protected what I can admit Am I testing truth or aversion I rehearsed? Every check I run and just returns me to the first That's your case is drifting to the frame On invite is still the same conditions I refuse to meet Now they're walking through my sleep Coverage says I'm almost there But there's something I don't share of passing Stick that feels too thin Like I feel the dirt out the risk with And I simulate what I can see Ignore the deeper dependency Every failure I dismiss Reappears inside the list Has this ever worked? But did I just avoid the truth? Did I build a frame? Out of everything I knew Am I testing past that I'm too afraid to take? Every line I skipped is another quiet break I'm not there I'm not there I'm not there I'm not there I'm not there I'm not there I'm not there Patterns echo Until they're known Signal surface On their own Not every flaw is there To hide some survive to realize So I let the failures take their place Read them like a trace, not a mistake Stop defending every pass Started seeing what might last As a version I resist living Just be on the list not incorrect Just end the fine waiting where the edges bind Maybe testing isn't proof Maybe it's a way to move Through uncertainty with care Instead of acting like it's clean Maybe this can work If I stop forcing every pass If I let it break And just hear what it asks Am I testing truth For learning how to see Every failing case is a clearer part of me It settles differently somehow No need to force it now One last quiet check, no rush Has this ever worked Not like this Maybe it can
